subject: Bug when running an app on the RStudio-hosted Shiny Server

messages.author: 0e32f06c8a213601
messages.subject: Bug when running an app on the RStudio-hosted Shiny Server
parts:
We have developed our first Shinyapp. It works very well locally and
you can have a look on R with the command shiny::runGist('4753900').
Nevertheless, there is a bug when running it on the RStudio-hosted
Shiny Server. Somme charts are not displayed, neither using Firefox,
IE nor Chrome. Instead the message “Error: invalid multibyte string 5”
is displayed. Have a look at http://glimmer.rstudio.com/ekipaj/TypoColi/
Could someone give a hand?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Bug when running an app on the RStudio-hosted Shiny Server
parts:
I downloaded that gist to my Glimmer account and it appears to work OK:

http://glimmer.rstudio.com/jcheng/TypoColi/

If your actual data file is different from what's in the gist, please make sure your data is UTF-8 encoded, or, provide a fileEncoding argument when calling read.table.
